report.summary:
Patient P-D003 (age 67, Original Medicare + Part D, no Medicare transport benefit; home census tract 17031440201) was screened 2026-10-01 and reports no current utilities shutoff risk and no transportation barrier. Tract profile shows 37.5% of households have no vehicle and high CDC PLACES shutoff-utility share (21.5%), so community options are still worth offering. Next scheduled appointment: cardiology 2026-10-16 11:00 (kept); no facility location on file, so a transit feasibility check could not be run.

Utilities resources found near tract 17031440201:
- Shutoff Prevention Clinic: walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays.
- Lakeside Energy Assistance: referral-tracking link available.
- Neighborhood Energy Help: income-based gas/electric bill help; apply in person Mon/Wed.

Transport resources found near tract 17031440201:
- Senior Shuttle West: free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. Patient is 67, so appears eligible by age.
- Paratransit Info Desk: ADA paratransit certification applications by phone (decisions up to 21 days).
- Medicaid Ride Line: not applicable—patient has Original Medicare, not Medicaid.

No phone numbers or addresses were returned by the resource directory; call the clinic front desk to obtain contact details before handing these to the patient.
